facts.fact: Kharif foodgrain and oilseed crops (all cereals, millets, pulses, oilseeds): the farmer pays at most 2.0% of the sum insured or the actuarial rate, whichever is less
facts.quote: 1 Kharif All foodgrain and Oilseeds crops(all Cereals, Millets, Pulses and Oilseeds crops) 2.0% of SI or Actuarial rate, whichever is less

facts.fact: Rabi foodgrain and oilseed crops: at most 1.5% of the sum insured or the actuarial rate, whichever is less
facts.quote: 2 Rabi All foodgrain and Oilseeds crops(all Cereals, Millets, Pulses and Oilseeds crops) 1.5% of SI or Actuarial rate, whichever is less

facts.fact: Annual commercial / annual horticultural crops (Kharif and Rabi): at most 5% of the sum insured or the actuarial rate, whichever is less
facts.quote: 3 Kharif and Rabi Annual Commercial / Annual Horticultural crops 5% of SI or Actuarial rate, whichever is less

facts.fact: Perennial horticultural / commercial crops (pilot basis): at most 5% of the sum insured or the actuarial rate, whichever is less
facts.quote: Perennial horticultural / commercial 5% of SI or Actuarial rate, crops (pilot basis) whichever is less

facts.fact: The rates (including the perennial pilot rate) are in the PMFBY Operational Guidelines; the latest are the 2023 Operational Guidelines listed on pmfby.gov.in
facts.quote: 2023 Operational Guidelines of Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - (PMFBY) 07/11/2024 3.60 MB Download
facts.note: The 2023 PDF itself is hosted on pmfby.amnex.co.in (not counted as official by the checker); its rate table matches the 2020 guidelines quoted here.

facts.fact: The rest of the actuarial premium is paid as subsidy by the Centre and the State 50:50, or 90:10 in North-Eastern and Himalayan States/UTs
facts.quote: The Central & State Governments subsidizes the remaining premium in 50:50 proportion. For the farmers in North- Eastern & Himalayan States/UTs, the contribution of Central & State Govt. subsidy is in a 90:10 proportion.

facts.fact: States/UTs may give additional subsidy from their own budget, so some States reduce the farmer's share further
facts.quote: However, the States/ UTs are free to extend additional subsidy over and above the normal subsidy from their budget.

facts.fact: The premium for a specific crop/district can be checked with the Insurance Premium Calculator on pmfby.gov.in
facts.quote: Do you want to know insurance premium before Crop Insurance? Then Click Below! Insurance Premium Calculator Know your insurance premium before Calculate Now

facts.fact: Premium paid by non-loanee farmers is rounded off to the nearest rupee
facts.quote: *Note: Premium paid by non loanee farmers should be rounded off to nearest Rupee.

summary: Premium caps 2%/1.5%/5% (FAQ) and 5% perennial pilot, State top-up subsidy and rounding (OG 2020) confirmed; 50:50 / 90:10 NE & Himalayan sharing confirmed by PIB backgrounder of 29 Aug 2026; premium calculator on pmfby.gov.in.
